# Structure-Based Generation

<!-- Generated by contract_docs.py; edit canonical definitions. -->

Use the authorized connector. Collect the user's required values; upload local file inputs
and substitute the returned platform references. The connector generates a readable
experiment name when one is omitted; report the returned name. Submit once, retain the job ID, poll
and inspect all returned artifacts. Never invent inputs or reuse another user's references.

## Structure-Based Generator

Generate small molecules for an uploaded protein binding-pocket structure, optionally filtering the generated molecules with selected property models.

Exact job name: `Structure_Based_Generator`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`. The connector generates `experiment_name` unless the user supplies one.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `protein_Path` | string | yes | file | Uploaded binding-pocket or protein `.pdb` path. Raw sequence, local paths, PDB text, and HTTP URLs are invalid. |
| `no_of_shapes` | integer | yes | value | Number of shapes to generate; minimum 1. Send an integer, not a string. |
| `no_of_decodings` | integer | yes | value | Number of decodings; minimum 1. Send an integer, not a string. |
| `model_category` | string | no / mode-dependent | value | Optional model category. The verified sample used exact value `ML`. |
| `custom_models` | array | no / mode-dependent | value | Selected custom models using the documented object fields below; use authorized model identifiers. |
| `global_models` | array | no / mode-dependent | value | Selected model objects with name, min_threshold and max_threshold; preserve user-supplied numeric bounds. |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

### Submission envelope

Shape only: replace placeholders with the user's values. This is not a runnable sample.
```json
{
  "job_name": "Structure_Based_Generator",
  "experiment_name": "<optional; generated if omitted>",
  "experiment_data": {
    "protein_Path": "<user value; see protein_Path schema>",
    "no_of_shapes": "<user value; see no_of_shapes schema>",
    "no_of_decodings": "<user value; see no_of_decodings schema>"
  }
}
```

For mode-dependent fields, include the fields required by the selected schema branch.

    ],
    "header_case_sensitive": true,
